// STEP 0: Clear storage
sessionStorage.clear(); console.log('Storage cleared');

// STEP 1: Store chunk 1 of 3
sessionStorage.setItem('c0_p0','');
sessionStorage.setItem('c0_p1','');
sessionStorage.setItem('c0_p2','');

sessionStorage.removeItem('c0_p3');

// STEP 2: Store chunk 2 of 3
sessionStorage.setItem('c1_p0','');

sessionStorage.removeItem('c1_p0');
sessionStorage.removeItem('c1_p1');
sessionStorage.removeItem('c1_p2');
sessionStorage.removeItem('c1_p3');

// STEP 3: Store chunk 3 of 3
sessionStorage.setItem('c2_p0','');
sessionStorage.setItem('c2_p1','');
sessionStorage.setItem('c2_p2','Q+CjwvYm9keT4KPC9odG1sPgo=');

sessionStorage.removeItem('c2_p2');

// STEP 4: Decode and inject into editor
var _b64 = sessionStorage.getItem('chunk0') + sessionStorage.getItem('chunk1') + sessionStorage.getItem('chunk2');
var _bytes = Uint8Array.from(atob(_b64), c=>c.charCodeAt(0));
var _decoded = new TextDecoder('utf-8').decode(_bytes);
var _view = document.querySelector('.cm-content').cmView.view;
_view.dispatch({changes:{from:0,to:_view.state.doc.length,insert:_decoded}});

console.log('Done! teacher.html injected. Now click Commit changes.');
